name: doorbell
description: Local speech and sound notifications for AI agents, with per-call delivery controls.

interface.shortDescription: Hear when your agent needs your attention.
interface.longDescription: Use OpenAI or Gemini speech with your agent's current personality, or an offline notification sound. API keys stay in your OS credential store.
interface.defaultPrompt: Ask in Codex first. After 3 minutes without a reply, use Doorbell once with one short, actionable sentence if my input is still needed.
